verdict.rationale: Numeral's docs describe agent access to its MCP server as authenticating with 'your existing Numeral secret API key' (numeral-docs-30), not a scoped or restricted-permission credential; there is no mention of read-only, role-based, or limited-scope API keys anywhere in the evidence pack. This suggests full-access credentials are handed to agents rather than least-privilege ones, and no scoped-credential issuance mechanism is documented.
